Abstract
We identified an effective chemotherapy regimen in patients refractory to standard chemotherapy. We included patients with unresectable colorectal liver metastases who underwent hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy and systemic chemotherapy between January 2015 and December 2022. This study was a retrospective analysis conducted at a single center. Of the 42 patients, 20 underwent HAIC-FOLFOX-B while 22 underwent HAIC-FOLFIRI-B treatment with response rates of 25% and 4.5%, respectively.
